description: Database migration script using Alembic and SQLAlchemy to create main tables and triggers for a FastAPI application, including users, articles, tags, followers, favorites, and commentaries.

methods.name: create_updated_at_trigger
methods.description: Creates a PostgreSQL trigger function to update 'updated_at' timestamp on row modification.

methods.name: timestamps
methods.description: Returns 'created_at' and 'updated_at' timestamp columns with default values and auto-update behavior.

methods.name: create_users_table
methods.description: Creates 'users' table with fields for username, email, salt, hashed_password, bio, image, and timestamps, plus a trigger for modtime updates.

methods.name: create_followers_to_followings_table
methods.description: Creates a join table for user followers and followings with composite primary key.

methods.name: create_articles_table
methods.description: Creates 'articles' table with fields for slug, title, description, body, author_id, and timestamps, plus a trigger for modtime updates.

methods.name: create_articles_to_tags_table
methods.description: Creates a join table linking articles and tags with composite primary key.

methods.name: create_favorites_table
methods.description: Creates 'favorites' table linking users and articles with composite primary key.

methods.name: create_commentaries_table
methods.description: Creates 'commentaries' table with body, author_id, article_id, timestamps, and a modtime trigger.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Executes functions to create all tables and triggers.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Drops all created tables and functions.
